snippet.title: Cosmorons Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Swing through gravitational fields, slingshot from asteroid to asteroid, and upgrade adaptive weapons and abilities to blast through enemies as you play as a Drudge, one of the comedic robots attempting to conquer the vast cosmos! 

This 1- 4 player arcade shooter is a mix of gravity-defying gameplay, slapstick-tinged parody, and a classic low-poly-inspired aesthetic all wrapped up in hours of addictive fun!

Wishlist Cosmorons on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590750/Cosmorons/
